fields.name: name

fields.name: relationshipType
fields.description: Relationship in the Open Gateway context. bundles is used when the id in the productRelationship is the id of a product bundled into the main product. appliesOn is used when the id in the productRelationship is the id of a product to which the main product applies on (like a usage volume product applies on an API product).

fields.name: description
fields.description: free-text description of the resource

fields.name: name
fields.description: the name of the resource

fields.name: operationalState
fields.description: ResourceOperationalStateType enumerations; values defined by ITU X.731: 'disable': The resource is totally inoperable and unable to provide service to the user(s); 'enable': The resource is partially or fully operable and available for use.

fields.name: resourceVersion
fields.description: A field that identifies the specific version of an instance of a resource.

fields.name: commercialName
fields.description: Exact name of the Application as marketed (and known by the end-user).

fields.name: logoUrl
fields.description: Url to retrieve the Application official logo.

fields.name: privacyPolicyURL
fields.description: Url to Application privacy policy, if applicable.

fields.name: jwksUri
fields.description: Uri pointing to a JSON Web Key (JWK) : data structure that represents a cryptographic key

fields.name: category
fields.description: Valid values for the category of the Application. Please refer to main Application stores in order to retrieve a more precise definition of the categories.

fields.name: approvalStatus
fields.description: Valid values for an ApprovalStatus in the context of an approval process.

fields.name: approvalStatusReason
fields.description: The reason why the approval state changed. DEPRECATED in the PATCH (bug to be fixed on next major version).

fields.name: creationDate
fields.description: Date and time when the Application was created

subResources.description: An identification of this resource that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the resource within the system and the unique ID of the resource within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single resource, e.g. if the resource passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system.

fields.name: owner
fields.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

fields.name: externalIdentifierType
fields.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

subResources.description: Contact information for the exercise of data protection rights to which the End Users can address. Must be only EmailContactMedium or WebFormContactMedium for this context.

fields.name: preferred
fields.description: If true, indicates that is the preferred contact medium

fields.name: contactType
fields.description: Type of the contact medium to qualify it like pro email / personal email. This is not used to define the contact medium used.

subResources.description: Each GSMA Service-API plays a role, and has specific permissions for use

children.description: The PermissionSet is a set of Permissions granted to a user (party, party role, resource or resource role). The set may be granted explicitly by an authorized user or may be acquired implicitly due to the role that the user is playing.

fields.name: creationDate
fields.description: Date when the PermissionSet was created and assigned to a user

fields.name: description
fields.description: Text describing the permission set
